banner.title: keda
banner.tagline: Runs the KEDA operator and metrics server, so a ScaledObject can scale a workload on an event source, down to zero.

explainer.title: The operator writes the HPA, the metrics server answers it

steps.title: Chart
steps.text: OCIRepository keda pulls the chart from the home-operations charts mirror at a pinned tag. Renovate bumps the tag.
steps.scene: a sealed container crate with a tag

steps.title: Operator
steps.text: keda-operator watches ScaledObject and ScaledJob resources, and creates the HorizontalPodAutoscaler that does the scaling.
steps.scene: a dial gauge on a control panel

steps.title: Metrics
steps.text: The metrics server serves the external metrics API that the HPA reads. If it is down, every scaled workload stops moving.
steps.scene: a radio tower broadcasting signal arcs

steps.title: Scale
steps.text: A workload that opts in gets a ScaledObject in its own namespace. KEDA scales it between its min and max, and to zero when allowed.
steps.scene: a bar chart rising from zero

art.about: how KEDA turns an event source into a scaled workload
art.title: How KEDA scales a workload
